recipe_version.title: Roasted Cauliflower Shawarma Plate
recipe_version.description: Roasted shawarma-spiced cauliflower with a salted tahini-garlic sauce, cucumber, and warm pita.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.doneness: Cauliflower charred at the edges and tender at the stem. Sauce drizzle-thin.

ingredients.name: shawarma spice blend
ingredients.note: Store-bought. Dairy, nuts, wheat, and sesame in the blend are not contracted.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: Juice of 1/2 in the sauce, juice of the other 1/2 on the cucumber.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 4 g on the cauliflower, 2 g in the tahini, 1 g on the cucumber. 7 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (2.5 tsp). The same weight is 1.5 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 1.25 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Roast the cauliflower
steps.body: Heat the oven to 425 F. Toss the cauliflower with the neutral oil, the shawarma spice blend, and 4 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Roast 25 minutes, until the edges char and a stem is tender.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Whisk the tahini with the grated garlic, the juice of 1/2 lemon, the water, and 2 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt until it drizzles.

steps.title: Warm the pita and plate
steps.body: Dice the cucumber and toss it with the remaining lemon juice and the remaining 1 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Warm the pita in foil for the last 3 minutes of the roast. Serve cauliflower, cucumber, sauce, and pita. Feta is not in this dish because this package does not claim a dairy-free or dairy contract for the spice blend, and feta would add a dairy allergen the recipe does not list.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Named foods have no meat, poultry, or fish, so plant stays. The store-bought shawarma blend is not contracted against milk, so dairy_free is not claimed. Not gluten-free. Not a nut-free blend.

culinary_revision.dietary: Sesame and wheat unchanged. Dairy in the spice blend stays uncontracted. hh001_eligible stays false. No feta added.

culinary_revision.uncertainties: Shawarma blends differ. If a blend is already very salty, the 4 g on the cauliflower is the amount to reduce at the taste of a roasted floret.
